comparisons.target: Eq. (9) versus independent Eq. (8a-d) work-balance reconstruction

discrepancies.target: PIP-3 Eq. (9) normalized ratio in Table 2
discrepancies.observation: Direct Eq. (9) evaluation with Table 1 inputs gives 0.705666, while Table 2 reports 0.66. PIP-1 and PIP-2 agree with Table 2 to rounding.
discrepancies.engineering_interpretation: The mismatch exceeds the two-decimal table rounding band. The independent Eq. (8a-d) work-balance reconstruction also gives approximately 0.7053, supporting the Eq. (9) calculation. The discrepancy is retained without tuning and requires source-author clarification or additional provenance before closure.
closure_requirements: Confirm Table 1 and Table 2 source transcription against the fingerprinted original.
Confirm the printed Eq. (9) form and normalization.
Obtain an additional provenance explanation, erratum, or documented engineering acceptance of the unresolved published-reference mismatch.
Do not tune source inputs to force the Table 2 value.

limitations: PIP-3 Eq. (9) / Table 2 discrepancy remains OPEN and is not tuned away.
Table 1 and Table 2 machine-readable values are source-bounded transcriptions; the original copyrighted PDF remains external.
The independent check is an analytical work-balance reconstruction, not an FE reproduction.
No source FE model is reproduced.
next_actions: Run local verification against the exact fingerprinted source PDF.
Seek an independent explanation or source-author clarification for PIP-3 Table 2 ratio 0.66 before closing P40-D001.
Only promote P40 to the live registry after local tests and review are accepted.
